rationale.edition: Classification is 'both': the change spans enterprise-owned paths (web/src/enterprise/**, o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/llm_evaluations/**, o2_openfga/src/meta/**) AND open-source paths (src/api/** management models/requests and http router, web/src/lib/core, web/src/plugins/traces, web/src/services, web/src/locales). The enterprise layer is the AI/LLM observability implementation while the OSS side carries shared core components, services, and API request/model plumbing.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The trigger comment is empty and no tests-added/skip label was supplied, so there is no explicit opt-out. The diff is not docs/CI-only: it adds substantial new user-facing UI views and pages (PlaygroundPage, ExperimentDetailPage, DatasetDetailPage, QualityPage) plus backend routes, so the change is user-exercisable.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the diff introduces several brand-new user-facing UI flows under web/src/enterprise/views/AIObservability (Playground page with variant columns/messages/output cells, Experiment browser and detail page, Dataset detail) plus onlineEvals pages (Quality page, scorer/score-config libraries). These are interactive, stateful flows a user can drive and verify in the browser.
rationale.area: Area is AIObservability: the bulk of the new UI lives under web/src/enterprise/views/AIObservability/ and web/src/enterprise/components/AIObservability/, with no existing Playwright area (Logs/Metrics/Traces/Dashboards/etc.) matching an LLM experiments/playground feature, so a new AIObservability area is the closest fit.
rationale.group: playwright_group is AIObservability: there is no existing matrix group for LLM experiments/playground in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix_env.json (existing groups are Logs-*, Dashboards-*, Alerts, Traces, SDR, etc.), so this is a sensible new group name and the Engineer must create it and register the spec in run_files.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. No files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/**/*.spec.js are changed. The many web/src/**/*.spec.ts files in the diff are Vitest unit tests (component/unit coverage), which do not count as E2E coverage per the rules.
